title: Sounds worth hearing
notes: The Dark is quieter: a low swallow, never twice in a breath; the long sting only for a topple, the Hollow waking, a surge.
A perfect is the biggest sound in the game: a bright note climbs the scale with your streak, with a thump underneath. Plain drops are half as loud.
Wind-true, keystone and second wind resolve on two notes; a forge shimmers.
